blocks.text: This first contents page for Volume II turns a dense OCR heading wall into a clearer guide to the early post-Banda episodes, from Chandialias and Tara Singh through Nawab Kapoor Singh, Bhai Mani Singh, Mehtab Singh, Sukha Singh, and Bhai Taru Singh.
Opening essays and the first cycle of warrior episodes

The page opens with Preface and Introduction, then lists the episode about Chandialias and Jandialas, those who harmed the Guru's cause and the Sikh Panth, those given to debauchery and irascibility, and a shocking companion episode.
Tara Singh, Randhawas, and Nawab Kapoor Singh

The next run gathers Tara Singh, the Invasion of Moman Khan, the account of how S. Tara Singh attained mantra, the Randhawas of Chamunday and Kairon, Nawab Kapoor Singh the Nihang chief, Mulkhayan and Biwastay with Dinikhudian, the title of nawabship on S. Kapoor Singh, Jassa Singh Ahluwalia, Nawab Kapoor Singh Bhujangi, and Bhai Mani Singh's martyrdom.
Nadar Shah, Zakaria Khan, Mehtab Singh, and Sukha Singh

The middle sequence highlights Nadar Shah, Khalsa's petition being heard in the divine court, Khanu Nawab and Nawab Zakaria Khan, Mehtab Singh and Sukha Singh, Bota Singh the martyr, the bravery of Bhai Sukha Singh, another episode about Sukha Singh, another episode about Sukha Singh's brave deeds, Mehtab Kot, Khalsa's conduct, and Subeg Singh Jambar.
The Bhai Taru Singh cluster and the Nawab Khan Bahadur close

The page closes with Bhai Taru Singh, a fearless martyr, Babur, Satguru Guru Nanak, another episode about Taru Singh, Mehtab Singh, Bhai Taru Singh again, the painful death of Nawab Khan Bahadur, and another episode about Nawab Khan Bahadur.
